violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Oven door gasket damaged/hanging loose.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment * that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Ice machine yellow debris buildup at interior panel. *Removed for cleaning while on-site. -Limescale/black debris build up at ice drop at interior upper surface of ice machine.
Lighting. — --Light intensity for walk-in refrigeration or food storage area was insufficient. -Light not working in walk in cooler.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth or sanitizer solution for wiping food spills was not clean. Cloth with sani spray and degreaser spray bottles were visibly soiled/dingy.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Ice machine has yellow debris buildup at bottom edge of interior panel.
